name: Cordway
summary: Cordway is a rope puzzle game for mobile. Ropes swing, slide and pull out of the board once the player finds the right order. The game combines six puzzle types: pulling ropes out in the correct order, re-plugging rope ends until nothing crosses, sorting rope rings by colour onto spools, connecting pins of the same colour, untangling pins so that no rope crosses another, and balancing pulley weights. Its 294 levels are spread across 42 stages, with mechanics such as screws, colour sockets, clamps, knots and master levels with limited moves. It features five visual themes (wood, marble, felt, neon, garden), a colour-blind mode, hints, free undo, a daily bonus and offline play.
